column1: # This is the ONE list in this repository that is chosen by a human: the keys
# worth knowing on day one, in the order a newcomer meets them. Everything else
# Curation is not a licence to drift. Every (table, key) below must exist in
# keys/generated/keys.tsv, and scripts/check-key-conflicts fails the build if
# one does not — so a key removed from the config cannot survive here.
# It feeds the Key Explorer's opening view and docs/keybindings/quick.md.
